tweets.title: Prior work extends diff rendering to also optimize physics params. But this needs ground-truth motion or multi-view videos (hard to obtain), or substitutes vide
tweets.body: Prior work extends diff rendering to also optimize physics params. But this needs ground-truth motion or multi-view videos (hard to obtain), or substitutes video diffusion priors. The catch: these methods are scene-specific, (very) slow, and often inaccurate (need good initialization).

tweets.body:
Why Learn Physics Field?

NeRF/3DGS capture static appearance but no dynamics.

PhysGaussian showed that in addition to the usual learned colors, appending physics params to each 3D point makes things move. But how would you even get those physics params in the first place?
